title: IPC endpoint lease changed
description:
The data of an `endpoint.lease_changed` event: the holder's lease was revoked — by an administrative revoke, by the endpoint being disabled, or at shutdown. A grant is learned from `hello_response`, never from this event, which therefore carries revocation only (matching `LocalSessionEvent::EndpointLeaseChanged`).

2.0.0 (ADR-0067 decision 7, IPC major 3): every EndpointId here is the derived id of `endpoints/endpoint-id` 2.0.0 -- the 52-character name of the endpoint's Ed25519 key -- and a label of the grammar ADR-0067 retired is refused; no reader of the earlier major tolerates the value, so the shape takes a major.
